news.title: Lenskart Q2 Results: Profit zooms 122% YoY to Rs 227 crore; revenue grows 36%
news.summary: Lenskart Solutions achieved a net profit of Rs 227.08 crore in Q2FY27, reflecting a 122.1% YoY increase. Revenue from operations rose to Rs 2,845.03 crore, marking a 35.7% YoY growth. Product margin improved to 64% compared to 63.4% in the same quarter last year. The company added 165 new stores in Q2FY27, enhancing its active store count to 3,624.

news.title: Allcargo Logistics Q2 Results: Co posts Rs 19 crore profit; revenue rises 3.4%
news.summary: Allcargo Logistics Ltd reported a positive shift in financial performance during the September quarter of FY27, achieving a consolidated profit after tax of Rs 19 crore. This demonstrates a year-on-year growth alongside a 3.4 percent increase in operational revenue. With the festive season on the horizon, the company anticipates further demand, focusing on enhancing capacity utilization and reinstating volume growth in the upcoming months.

news.title: Bayer CropScience Q2 profit rises 9% to Rs 166 crore despite 19% decline in revenue
news.summary: Bayer CropScience Ltd has announced an impressive 8.84% growth in net profit, totaling Rs 166.2 crore for Q2 FY27. However, total income saw a 19.4% decline year-over-year, attributed to ongoing market challenges. Factors such as unpredictable monsoon patterns have disrupted both sowing and crop protection demand. In response, the company emphasizes efficiency improvements and portfolio enhancements, while the board has declared an interim dividend of Rs 90 per share.

news.title: Saregama India Q2 net profit jumps over 46% to Rs 64.2 cr, revenue grows 36.6%
news.summary: Saregama India has reported an impressive 46.4 percent rise in its consolidated net profit for the September quarter. Alongside this, the company’s operational revenue saw a 36.63 percent increase, with the music segment generating Rs 251.3 crore and live events thriving remarkably. The total income for the first half of FY27 reached Rs 587.28 crore, showcasing solid financial results.
